answer_1.quote: In the field of natural language processing, many efforts have been made to enhance computational models... for sequence-to-sequence tasks such as machine translation, text summarization and dialogue generation... In image caption, the caption can be organized with a bag of attribute words extracted from the image.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences from a bag of words

answer_2.quote: we employ four automatic evaluation metrics to evaluate the quality of a generated sentence from different aspects. PMR (Perfect Matching Ratio) measures... BLEU... ROUGE-L... WAcc...

answer_4.quote: we also conduct human evaluations to further analyze our generated results... We invited humans to organize the target sentence regarding the input bag using crowd-sourcing... we invite four educated annotators to judge the quality of 100 randomly sampled sentences... Annotators were asked to judge whether a generated sentence is grammatical and the meaning of a generated sentence is the same as the ground truth.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged grammaticality and semantic equivalence to the ground truth.
